A '''funeral''' was held for the esteemed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]] after the latter died on an ill-fated mission on behalf of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that attended the funeral were shocked when Bouri's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] refused to deliver a eulogy to his former master, prompting [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to do it himself.
